text:
# filter.priceMin

TL;DR:
- filter.priceMin sets the minimum listing price.

What it means:
- It removes cheaper listings below the requested price floor.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the user wants to avoid items below a given budget floor or is specifying a price range.
